separate_layers: A photographic image may be copyrighted by its photographer; a 'viewable' webpage image is not a reuse license.
A photograph primarily showing a protected public sculpture raises a separate rights issue for the underlying artwork.
Norwegian Copyright Act section 31 does not provide an unconditional right for commercial reuse where the sculpture clearly is the main subject.
No assumption that a Wikimedia Commons CC license for a park-wide landscape authorizes all close-up uses of a sculpture.
Do not download, transform, or publish unlicensed isolated work photographs or generate identity-claiming reconstructions.
image_rights.review_type: Editorial rights screen, not a legal opinion

classification_policy.structures: Skulpturparken is already correctly one physical park/byrom Structure; do not duplicate it as a new Place.
classification_policy.art_objects: These eight works are physically present as reported by the museum and eligible for later object/artwork-specific content review, not automatic active Objects.
classification_policy.no_filler: Keep Tjuvholmen curated PlaceCard collection_ids ['people','brands','structures']; no unapproved fourth Objects round.
classification_policy.separate_works_question: RESOLVED IN PRINCIPLE: installed physical sculptures are By Objects candidates; artworks as creative works belong to Productions/cultural layer, not as duplicate PlaceCard entities. No candidate is activated while rights and images remain uncleared.

entity_routing_decision.physical_installation: Each individually documented, site-anchored public sculpture is a potential By Object (monument/public-art object), subject to distinct physical-identity, media, provenance and rights acceptance under docs/PLACE_OBJECTS_CANONICAL.md.
entity_routing_decision.artwork_as_work: Artist/title/year and the intellectual artwork are Works/Productions-level concepts; not eight automatic Productions collection entries on this By PlaceCard.
entity_routing_decision.parent_structure: Skulpturparken på Skjæret stays a single Structure; no duplicate Structure or Place for any work.
entity_routing_decision.preview_requirement: No Object or artwork preview becomes active until both photographer permission and artwork reproduction rights are suitable for the actual intended use. A website picture or a photographer-only CC grant is insufficient on its own.
entity_routing_decision.read_only_text: Source-backed factual titles, artists, years and ownership may remain in editorial research and educational descriptions without reproducing artwork images.
